The remote-workspaces-in-ci spec (`specs/remote-workspaces-in-ci.md`) now records that `minds-admin env deploy` copies the tier box registry's `ready` `bare_metal_servers` rows into every dynamic env's `host_pool` DB itself (for any tier whose `secrets/minds/<tier>/neon/DATABASE_URL` leaf is populated -- dev included, via `minds-dev-infra`), so the CI orchestrator's explicit `minds-admin server import-boxes` step is now the post-sweep refresh rather than the only import.
